source: PC NFH2, the anger gauge's jumps in Badinfos' 100 % run (tools/pcref/amounts.py: the jump per second scaled to the full bar, 92 % of the crop, labelled with the HUD bubble's activity) — a jump that hits the full bar is a lower bound and keeps the mobile value where that is higher; a jump shared by linked coins is split in the mobile proportions; an unmeasured coin keeps the mobile value. E07 Mummy's Darling: +19 the board (123 s), +25 the elephant (170), +25 the shell (193), +25 and +25 the castle with its towel (221, 225), +32 at the full bar in his second elephant visit — the awning (239), +12 on the full bar (279). PC data (in_b1/tricks.xml, rage per trick in thousandths of the gauge): the mobile AngerAmount values are the PC's for every trick this level pays — no overlay. The gauge jumps read off Badinfos' video (2026-09-08) ran 10-25 %% high and are withdrawn. The gauge is 100 000 rage long — the mobile's AngryMeterMaximum 100: the PC dialog (nfh2 dialogs/*/menuleft_bar.xml) gives the rageometer range 0..100000 and GameLogic.dll flags 100000 (docs/PC_ROUTINES.md); the 80 read off the video was the bar's geometry, as the Season 1 tube's was. Its decay is the mobile's 0.37 %/s: the bar falls 41 -> 11 % over 70 trick-free seconds of E01 (tools/pcref/gauge.py, x0.8 for the crop).
